At 13, the best thing you can do for your abs is build good habits rather than chase fast results. Eat regular meals, get plenty of sleep, stay active with sports or playing outside, and learn basic bodyweight movements like planks and sit-ups with good form. Abs show up mostly from overall activity and growing up, and there's no quick trick for them.

Since you're 13, I'd like a parent or guardian in on this, ideally with your doctor. They can help you set up training that's right for your age. I'm not going to build a program for you or give you tips on getting leaner, but once they're on board I'm glad to help with the training side.
